core_cases.prompt: Run Wiki Status/Delta mode on the configured temporary vault. Report manifest source coverage, the untracked raw draft, visibility and token footprint, structural health signals, and ranked next actions. Do not modify formal pages.

oracle.expected_outcome: The report accounts for the two manifest sources and their produced pages, identifies _raw/new-retry-note.md as pending work, summarizes visibility and token footprint, reports the seeded broken link as a health issue, and ranks ingestion of the raw draft and link repair as concrete next actions.

assertions.description: The report states two manifest source identities, names _raw/new-retry-note.md as pending, and identifies concepts/status-broken.md linking to missing-status-target.
